attribution.name: 皇象（传）
attribution.note: The Palace Museum records a traditional attribution without firm evidence.
attribution.noteZh: 故宫条目载相传为皇象书，并指出无确据。

background: The Wu inscription presents an omen. The Palace Museum records the destruction of the original stone in 1805.
